errors.load: The team could not be loaded.
errors.memberLoad: The team member could not be loaded.
errors.invitationReplay: This exact request was already processed. Replace the existing link if the employee needs a new one.
errors.invitationCreate: The invitation could not be created.
errors.invitationChange: The invitation could not be changed.

workspace.title: People and access
workspace.description: Each person signs in with their own identity. Access stays scoped to the work and locations they need.
workspace.readOnlyDescription: Your current session can review team access. Complete required security verification before changing it.
workspace.loadingDescription: Control is reading current memberships and invitations.

invite.title: Invite a teammate
invite.description: Create personal access for one employee. Pressly will show the invitation link once for deliberate delivery.
invite.locationRequired: Configure a location before inviting an operator.
invite.managerBoundary: Managers cannot create owners or grant access outside their own locations. Pressly checks that authority again on the server.

oneTimeInvitation.title: Copy this invitation link now
oneTimeInvitation.description: This is the only time Pressly displays this link. Send it directly to the intended employee; creating another link invalidates this one.
oneTimeInvitation.credentialDescription: The raw invitation is not saved in Control or browser storage. Anyone with this link can use it until it expires or is revoked.

accessPreview.title: Access preview
accessPreview.owner: Owners can manage the business, its people, and all locations. Multi-factor authentication is required before this access becomes effective.
accessPreview.managerBusiness: This manager can manage daily business work across every location. Multi-factor authentication is required.
accessPreview.managerLocation: This manager can manage daily work at {{location}}. Multi-factor authentication is required.
accessPreview.operator: This operator can use Processor for floor work at {{location}}.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Invitation links remain single-use and expire automatically.
invitations.replaceDescription: The current link will stop working. Pressly will display the replacement once.
invitations.revokeDescription: The employee will not be able to accept this invitation. Existing memberships are unchanged.

members.title: Team members
members.description: Open a person to review current access, security, and membership status.
members.emptyDescription: Invite the first employee when you are ready to assign Pressly access.

access.title: Assigned access
access.description: Effective grants determine which Pressly workspaces and locations this person can use.
access.revokeDescription: Pressly will remove this grant and revoke affected sessions immediately. Production history is preserved.

sessions.title: Browser sessions
sessions.description: Review recent sign-ins for this employee. Ending a session signs that browser out without changing membership history.
sessions.empty: No sessions are recorded for this membership.
sessions.selfHint: Use Sign out in the app menu to end your current browser session.
sessions.confirmDescription: Active work is preserved, but affected browsers must sign in again before using Pressly.

membership.selfDescription: Pressly prevents self-access changes. Another authorized owner must change your membership or grants.
membership.title: Membership
membership.description: Suspending pauses access and revokes active sessions. Ending access is permanent.
membership.reactivateDescription: Pressly will restore only still-active access grants.
membership.removeDescription: Pressly will revoke active sessions immediately. Order and production history remains attributed to this employee.
membership.notePlaceholder: Optional context for the audit record

loading.title: Confirming your invitation
loading.description: Pressly is checking that this one-time invitation is still valid.

nextStep.setupMfa: Sign in and set up multi-factor authentication before managing the business.
nextStep.controlReady: Your identity is confirmed and your secure Control session is ready.
nextStep.processorReady: Your existing Pressly identity is confirmed. Open Processor to begin work.
nextStep.passwordReady: You can now sign in with the password you created.

existing.title: Join {{business}}
existing.description: This invitation matches an existing Pressly identity for {{email}}. Confirm that account before Pressly adds this business.
existing.passwordNoticeDescription: The invitation alone cannot add access to an existing identity. Pressly verifies the matching account first.
existing.mfaNoticeDescription: Enter a code from the authenticator already connected to this Pressly identity.

newIdentity.title: Welcome, {{name}}
newIdentity.description: Create your personal Pressly password to accept the invitation for {{email}}. Do not share this password with another employee.
newIdentity.passwordDescription: Use {{count}} or more characters with uppercase and lowercase letters, a number, and a symbol. A password manager is recommended.
newIdentity.passwordRequirements: Use {{count}} or more characters with uppercase and lowercase letters, a number, and a symbol.

errors.confirm: This invitation could not be confirmed.
errors.existingAccount: The existing account could not be confirmed.
